description: A snapshot of one context window: the budget it is measured against, the sections it is made of and the share of the prompt the provider served from its cache. It is a SNAPSHOT — TmContextUsage never mutates it and never polls anything, so a host pushes a new instance as the conversation grows (SignalR, polling, a server-side channel). BudgetTokens of 0 or less means the budget is UNKNOWN: nothing is measurable, so the component reports the used amount with no percentage, claims no over-budget verdict and divides by nothing.
